title: Boston Gas Company submits for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy, a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with Bicknell & Fuller, Inc.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: Supplemental Response to Information Requests AG-1-2. By Thomas P. O'Neill. GC 00-06

The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC 00-06)
Boston Gas Company's responses to the First Set of Information Requests of the Attorney General numbered 1-1 though 1-11. By: Thomas P. O'Neil, Counsel Eastern Enterprises.
Attorney General's First Set of Data and information Requests. By: John M. Grugan, Assistant Attorney General. (GC 00-06)
